articles.title: Miraculous Corp and ActivNation Partner to Launch IP-Based FEC Chain Starting 2028
articles.summary: Miraculous Corp and ActivNation have announced a partnership to develop Miraculous: Land of Heroes, a new chain of location-based entertainment destinations inspired by the globally popular Miraculous franchise, with the first venues opening in 2028. The deal signals growing momentum for IP-driven FEC concepts that leverage established fan bases to drive foot traffic. FEC operators and investors should take note of this model as a blueprint for leveraging entertainment IPs to differentiate in a crowded market.

articles.title: ESAC Uses Shanghai WUNPARK Case Study to Outline 2027 FEC Design Trends
articles.summary: Industry design firm ESAC is drawing on the Shanghai WUNPARK project to highlight a major shift in FEC design philosophy, moving away from pure attraction mix toward social destination concepts. The analysis points to key 2027 trends including community-focused layouts, dwell-time optimization, and experiential retail integration. FEC operators planning new builds or renovations should closely examine these emerging design principles to stay competitive.

articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $302.6M in Q3 2026 Revenue with Net Loss
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $302.64 million but posted an EPS of negative $0.21, highlighting the ongoing profitability challenges facing large-scale FEC and entertainment venue operators. The results offer a useful financial benchmark for investors and operators tracking the sector's recovery and margin dynamics. Understanding these figures is critical context for anyone evaluating the economics of multi-venue FEC businesses.

articles.title: MediaMation Showcases Cost-Effective Flying Theater System for FECs at IAAPA 2026
articles.summary: MediaMation is presenting its MX4D Motion EFX Bantam Flying Theater at IAAPA Expo 2026, positioning it as an affordable high-impact attraction for family entertainment centers and smaller theme parks seeking to maximize ROI. The system has already seen commercial success, with Flight of Aloha in Hawaii operating one and expanding to a full-scale version opening December 2026. FEC operators looking to add a premium, immersive ride experience without the capital outlay of a full-size flying theater should consider this product.

articles.title: Masha and the Three Bears Franchise Launches First Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: The popular children's IP Masha and the Three Bears is expanding into location-based entertainment with its first dedicated family entertainment center. The move continues the trend of beloved children's brands converting fan loyalty into physical venue concepts. FEC developers and operators should monitor this IP-to-venue pipeline as a signal of continued growth in themed entertainment partnerships.

articles.title: Betson Named Exclusive North American Distributor of Andamiro's Mickey & Friends Coin Pusher
articles.summary: Betson Enterprises has secured exclusive North American distribution rights for Andamiro's new six-player Mickey & Friends coin pusher, which will debut at IAAPA Expo 2026. The game combines Disney IP with a proven redemption game format, making it a likely high-performer on FEC arcade floors. Operators attending IAAPA should prioritize evaluating this title given the proven appeal of Disney branding with family audiences.

articles.title: Dreamland Playground Brings Full FEC Concept and Equipment Solutions to IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Dreamland Playground, a Wenzhou-based manufacturer of commercial indoor playground and FEC equipment, is exhibiting at IAAPA Expo 2026 with a focus on helping operators design complete family entertainment spaces. The company offers turnkey FEC planning support covering visitor flow, play zones, party spaces, and active attractions. FEC operators in early-stage development or looking to expand their equipment mix should visit booth S2896.

articles.title: Dynamic Creatures and Hasbro's Sixth Wall Studio Partner to Deploy AI-Powered Interactive Character Robots
articles.summary: Dynamic Creatures and Hasbro's new AI studio Sixth Wall are collaborating to bring Hasbro characters to life through expressive, mobile robots capable of genuine two-way guest interaction powered by CharacterOS. The partnership merges Sixth Wall's character intelligence platform with Dynamic Creatures' physical robotics, creating encounters where characters can greet guests, send them on adventures, and follow up afterward. For FEC operators, this represents a new tier of interactive character experience that could significantly enhance guest engagement and differentiation.

articles.title: Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Studio Establish Partnership for Hasbro Interactive Robots
articles.summary: This InPark report confirms the Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Studio collaboration to deploy AI-driven interactive robots embodying Hasbro characters in live entertainment settings. The combination of behavioral AI and physical robotics marks a significant step forward for character-based guest experiences. FEC operators with IP licensing agreements or character-driven theming should track this technology closely.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Adding Major FEC Expansion at South Plains Mall
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is expanding its South Plains Mall location to include a large new family entertainment center, reflecting the ongoing trend of cinema operators diversifying into broader entertainment offerings to drive traffic and revenue. This type of cinema-plus-FEC hybrid model is becoming increasingly common as theaters seek to compete with home streaming. FEC suppliers and operators should monitor this deal as a case study in anchor-tenant-driven FEC development.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment Center has opened a new venue in Denton, Texas, continuing the brand's expansion in the competitive Texas market. The opening adds to the growing roster of active entertainment chains establishing multi-unit presences in suburban markets. This is a useful data point for competitors and investors tracking FEC expansion velocity in the Sun Belt region.

articles.title: Former Fort Wayne Supermarket Being Converted Into Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket in Fort Wayne, Indiana is being repurposed as an indoor slide park, illustrating the continued trend of adaptive reuse of large retail spaces for active entertainment venues. This type of conversion is increasingly attractive given the abundance of vacant big-box and grocery retail space at favorable lease rates. FEC developers looking for cost-effective real estate strategies should take note of this model.

articles.title: New Indoor Entertainment Venue with Multiple Activities Coming to Amble, UK
articles.summary: A new multi-activity indoor entertainment venue is set to open in Amble, Northumberland, bringing diversified entertainment options to an underserved UK market. The venue reflects growing international appetite for FEC-style concepts beyond major urban centers. UK-based FEC operators and suppliers should monitor smaller-market openings as indicators of geographic market expansion.

articles.title: SimEx-Iwerks and BBC Studios Extend Partnership with New 4D Experience Lineup
articles.summary: SimEx-Iwerks and BBC Studios have extended their licensing partnership and will offer new 4D experiences inspired by the BBC's acclaimed Mammals series, available worldwide from March 2027. These turnkey 4D film experiences are well-suited for FEC theater installations, aquariums, and science centers seeking premium, branded content. FEC operators running 4D theaters or considering adding one should evaluate this new content pipeline.

articles.title: Christie to Present Projection Mapping Spotlight Session at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Christie will host a dedicated Spotlight Session on projection mapping at IAAPA Expo 2026, with its technologies also featured across multiple partner booths on the show floor. Projection mapping is increasingly relevant for FEC operators looking to create immersive theming, dark ride overlays, and event-driven experiences without costly physical set changes. This session is worth attending for operators exploring how projection technology can enhance guest experiences.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Unveils Steampunk-Themed Trackless Dark Ride Platform at IAAPA
articles.summary: DOF Robotics has developed a trackless dark ride vehicle platform capable of full 360-degree rotation, seating four to eight guests and synchronized with high-resolution projection mapping and multisensory effects. The platform offers FEC and attraction operators a highly flexible storytelling vehicle that can be adapted to a wide variety of themed experiences. With its modular narrative capabilities, this system could be a strong investment for mid-to-large FEC operators seeking to anchor a venue with a signature ride.

articles.title: California's Great America to Close After 2027 Season
articles.summary: California's Great America in Santa Clara has announced that 2027 will be its final operating season, ending a 51-year run as one of the Bay Area's major amusement parks. The closure signals ongoing challenges for standalone regional amusement parks competing in high-cost real estate markets. FEC operators and investors should take note of the broader regional park market dynamics this closure reflects.

articles.title: Disney Imagineering Launches AI and Games App at Disneyland, Testing Next-Gen Park Interactions
articles.summary: Walt Disney Imagineering has introduced the Disney Imagineering Labs app at Disneyland, offering interactive in-park experiences including AI-driven games for Magic Key holders. The app is explicitly framed as an R&D platform for testing next-generation guest experience concepts, with the first experience being a story-based game called Secrets of the Spire. FEC tech innovators should monitor this initiative closely as it previews where app-driven in-venue engagement is headed.

articles.title: Wisconsin Pub Adds Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Revenue
articles.summary: A pub in Beloit, Wisconsin has installed indoor golf simulators to maintain revenue and foot traffic during the winter off-season, demonstrating how hospitality venues are blending F&B with active entertainment. This model of layering simulator-based sports entertainment into existing food and beverage venues is a growing trend that FEC operators can learn from. The addition highlights the low barrier to entry for golf simulator installations as a revenue diversification strategy.

articles.title: Six Flags Hires New Chief Procurement Officer as It Restructures Post-Merger
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment has appointed Adam Boal as chief procurement officer, bringing expertise in managing billions of dollars in corporate spend and supplier partnerships from his previous role at CBRE. The hire signals Six Flags' focus on operational efficiency and supply chain optimization as it integrates its expanded park portfolio. FEC suppliers doing business with Six Flags should anticipate a more structured and performance-driven procurement process.

articles.title: Miniso Friends Immersive Retail-Experience Concept to Launch in UK
articles.summary: Miniso is bringing its Miniso Friends format to the UK with a 6,600-square-foot flagship store in Cardiff featuring IP toy zones, blind boxes, licensed merchandise, and immersive themed areas designed to extend dwell time. The format blurs the line between retail and entertainment, turning a shopping visit into a destination experience. FEC operators integrating retail should study this model for how IP-led immersive shopping concepts drive repeat visits and secondary spend.

articles.title: Universal Epic Universe Announces New Indoor Coaster for Dark Universe Land
articles.summary: Universal Epic Universe has revealed an upcoming indoor roller coaster set within its Dark Universe themed land, inspired by the Universal Monsters franchise. The attraction adds to the growing lineup of immersive, story-driven coasters that set a new experiential benchmark for themed entertainment. FEC operators and attraction designers should track Epic Universe's opening closely as it will likely reset guest expectations for immersive ride experiences.

articles.title: IRT iROC Launches Live Manufacturer-Operator Chat Series for Ride Safety Training
articles.summary: The International Ride Training iROC program is launching a quarterly Live Operator-Manufacturer Chat series, beginning with a session on building strong manufacturer-operator relationships and including 20-30 minutes of targeted education per session. This initiative addresses a recognized gap in ongoing ride safety communication between FEC operators and equipment manufacturers. FEC operators running rides and inflatables should engage with this program to strengthen their safety compliance and training protocols.

articles.title: Programming and Planning: The Invisible Force Behind Great Attraction Guest Experiences
articles.summary: A new editorial in Blooloop argues that behind-the-scenes programming and operational planning is the most underappreciated driver of guest satisfaction in themed attractions and entertainment venues. The piece draws on industry research to show that frictionless experiences, pacing, and event programming create emotional connections that tangible theming alone cannot. FEC operators focused purely on physical design should consider how their programming strategy shapes overall guest satisfaction and repeat visitation.

articles.title: Downtown FabWorks Sends Full Leadership Team to IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Downtown FabWorks, a turnkey fabrication provider for the attractions industry, is sending six members of its leadership and project management team to IAAPA Expo 2026, signaling a strong commitment to business development at the industry's flagship event. The company offers creative fabrication solutions relevant to FEC theming, dark rides, and immersive environments. FEC operators planning new builds or retheming projects should schedule time with the team at IAAPA.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Appoints Chief Growth Officer and Expands Client Services
articles.summary: Memoir Creative has named Kevin Kreczko as its new Chief Growth Officer as the design and fabrication firm expands its capabilities from a 50,000-square-foot production facility with more than 40 full-time staff. The appointment positions Memoir for increased project volume in themed entertainment, museums, and experiential retail. FEC developers and operators seeking fabrication and creative production partners should take note of Memoir's expanding capacity.

articles.title: Madison County Considers $11.7M in TIF Bonds for Retail and Dining Development Including Entertainment
articles.summary: Madison County is holding a public hearing on up to $11.741 million in Tax Increment Financing bonds to support a retail, dining, and entertainment development. TIF financing for mixed-use entertainment districts is an increasingly common funding mechanism for FEC-anchored developments across the US. FEC developers and operators exploring public-private partnership financing should follow this case as a model for municipal entertainment investment.

articles.title: WhiteWater Appoints Michael Dalzell as VP of Global Marketing
articles.summary: WhiteWater, a global leader in water-based attractions and waterpark equipment, has named Michael Dalzell as Vice President of Global Marketing, bringing over 20 years of brand and commercial growth experience from companies including The North Face. The hire reflects WhiteWater's focus on strengthening its brand positioning as competition in the waterpark attraction segment intensifies. FEC operators with waterpark or aquatic attraction components should monitor WhiteWater's evolving product and marketing direction.
